<svg viewBox="0 0 372 246" role="img" lang="en" aria-labelledby="archify-diagram-title archify-diagram-description" data-animation="trace" data-preset="classic" data-quality-profile="showcase" data-tree-ui="" data-tree-direction="down" data-reader-fit="intrinsic-height" data-reader-min-text="7.5">
        <title id="archify-diagram-title">tree</title>
        <desc id="archify-diagram-description">A hierarchy diagram generated by Archify.</desc>
        <!-- Definitions -->
        <defs>
          <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
            <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" class="m-default" />
          </marker>
          <marker id="arrowhead-emphasis" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
            <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" class="m-emphasis" />
          </marker>
          <marker id="arrowhead-security" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
            <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" class="m-security" />
          </marker>
          <marker id="arrowhead-dashed" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
            <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" class="m-dashed" />
          </marker>
          <pattern id="grid" width="40" height="40" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
            <path d="M 40 0 L 0 0 0 40" class="c-grid" stroke-width="0.5"/>
          </pattern>
        </defs>
        <style>
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-hue-root { --tree-hue: var(--text-muted); --tree-wash: transparent; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-hue-backend { --tree-hue: var(--backend-stroke); --tree-wash: var(--backend-fill); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-hue-database { --tree-hue: var(--database-stroke); --tree-wash: var(--database-fill); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-hue-cloud { --tree-hue: var(--cloud-stroke); --tree-wash: var(--cloud-fill); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-hue-frontend { --tree-hue: var(--frontend-stroke); --tree-wash: var(--frontend-fill); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-hue-messagebus { --tree-hue: var(--messagebus-stroke); --tree-wash: var(--messagebus-fill); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-hue-external { --tree-hue: var(--external-stroke); --tree-wash: var(--external-fill); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-edge { stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-edge-trunk { stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 18%, var(--arrow)); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-edge-hued { stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tree-hue) 42%, var(--arrow)); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-root { fill: var(--text); stroke: none; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-depth="0"] .tree-label { fill: var(--mask); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-depth="0"] .tree-sublabel { fill: var(--mask); opacity: 0.68; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-branch { fill: var(--tree-wash); stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tree-hue) 48%, var(--lane-stroke)); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-leaf { fill: var(--mask); stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tree-hue) 22%, var(--lane-stroke)); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-socket { fill: var(--mask); stroke: var(--tree-hue); pointer-events: none; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-accent { stroke: var(--tree-hue); pointer-events: none; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-stack] { display: none; fill: var(--mask); stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tree-hue) 70%, var(--lane-stroke)); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-collapsed] [data-tree-stack] { display: inline; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-hidden] { display: none; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-toggle-hit { fill: transparent; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-toggle-disc { fill: var(--mask); stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tree-hue) 55%, var(--lane-stroke)); transition: stroke 0.15s ease, fill 0.15s ease; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-toggle-glyph { stroke: var(--text-muted); fill: none; transition: stroke 0.15s ease; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-toggle-count { display: none; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-count-pill { fill: var(--tree-hue); stroke: none; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] .tree-toggle-count text { fill: var(--mask); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-toggle] { cursor: pointer; outline: none; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-toggle][aria-expanded="true"] .tree-toggle-plus { display: none; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-toggle][aria-expanded="false"] .tree-toggle-count { display: inline; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-toggle][aria-expanded="false"] .tree-toggle-disc { fill: var(--tree-hue); stroke: var(--tree-hue); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-toggle][aria-expanded="false"] .tree-toggle-glyph { stroke: var(--mask); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-toggle]:hover .tree-toggle-disc,
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-toggle]:focus-visible .tree-toggle-disc { stroke: var(--tree-hue); stroke-width: 2; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-toggle]:hover .tree-toggle-glyph,
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-toggle]:focus-visible .tree-toggle-glyph { stroke: var(--text); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-expand-all] { cursor: pointer; outline: none; }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-expand-all] rect { fill: var(--mask); stroke: var(--lane-stroke); }
          svg[data-tree-ui] [data-tree-expand-all]:is(:hover, :focus-visible) rect { stroke: var(--arrow-emphasis); stroke-width: 2; }
          svg[data-tree-ui]:not([data-tree-any-collapsed]) [data-tree-expand-all] { display: none; }
        </style>

        <!-- Background Grid -->
        <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#grid)" />

        <!-- Containment links -->
        <path data-edge-from="root" data-edge-to="api" data-edge-key="0" data-tree-ancestors="root" data-composition-points="186,105;186,133;102,133;102,161" d="M 186 105 L 186 123 Q 186 133 176 133 L 112 133 Q 102 133 102 143 L 102 161" class="a-default tree-edge tree-edge-trunk" data-animate="edge" style="--step:1" stroke-width="1.8"/>
        <path data-edge-from="root" data-edge-to="redis" data-edge-key="1" data-tree-ancestors="root" data-composition-points="186,105;186,133;270,133;270,161" d="M 186 105 L 186 123 Q 186 133 196 133 L 260 133 Q 270 133 270 143 L 270 161" class="a-default tree-edge tree-edge-trunk" data-animate="edge" style="--step:1" stroke-width="1.8"/>

        <!-- Nodes -->
        <g id="node-root" data-node-id="root" data-node-label="Platform" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Focus Platform, Root" aria-pressed="false" data-node-kind="frontend" data-node-context="Root" data-tree-depth="0" class="tree-hue-root">
          <title>Platform · Root</title>
          <rect data-tree-stack="" x="121" y="69" width="140" height="41" rx="10" class="tree-stack-frontend" stroke-width="1.2"/>
          <rect x="116" y="64" width="140" height="41" rx="10" class="c-mask"/>
          <rect x="116" y="64" width="140" height="41" rx="10" class="c-frontend tree-root" data-animate="node" style="--step:0" stroke-width="0"/>


          <text data-node-label="" x="186" class="t-primary tree-label" font-size="14.5" font-weight="750" text-anchor="middle"><tspan x="186" y="88.5">Platform</tspan></text>

        </g>
        <g id="node-api" data-node-id="api" data-node-label="API" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Focus API, Leaf" aria-pressed="false" data-node-kind="external" data-node-context="Leaf" data-tree-depth="1" data-tree-ancestors="root" class="tree-hue-backend">
          <title>API · Leaf</title>

          <rect x="32" y="161" width="140" height="41" rx="10" class="c-mask"/>
          <rect x="32" y="161" width="140" height="41" rx="10" class="c-external tree-leaf" data-animate="node" style="--step:1" stroke-width="1"/>

          <circle cx="102" cy="161" r="2.6" class="tree-socket" stroke-width="1.4"/>
          <text data-node-label="" x="102" class="t-primary tree-label" font-size="13" font-weight="560" text-anchor="middle"><tspan x="102" y="185.5">API</tspan></text>

        </g>
        <g id="node-redis" data-node-id="redis" data-node-label="Redis" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Focus Redis, Leaf" aria-pressed="false" data-node-kind="external" data-node-context="Leaf" data-tree-depth="1" data-tree-ancestors="root" class="tree-hue-database">
          <title>Redis · Leaf</title>

          <rect x="200" y="161" width="140" height="41" rx="10" class="c-mask"/>
          <rect x="200" y="161" width="140" height="41" rx="10" class="c-external tree-leaf" data-animate="node" style="--step:1" stroke-width="1"/>

          <circle cx="270" cy="161" r="2.6" class="tree-socket" stroke-width="1.4"/>
          <text data-node-label="" x="270" class="t-primary tree-label" font-size="13" font-weight="560" text-anchor="middle"><tspan x="270" y="185.5">Redis</tspan></text>

        </g>

        <!-- Branch toggles -->
        <g data-tree-toggle="root" data-tree-count="2" data-tree-label-collapse="Collapse Platform (2 below)" data-tree-label-expand="Expand Platform (2 hidden)" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="true" aria-label="Collapse Platform (2 below)" class="tree-hue-root">
          <circle cx="186" cy="105" r="14.5" class="tree-toggle-hit"/>
          <circle cx="186" cy="105" r="7.5" class="tree-toggle-disc" stroke-width="1.2"/>
          <path class="tree-toggle-glyph" d="M 182.85 105 H 189.15" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <path class="tree-toggle-glyph tree-toggle-plus" d="M 186 101.85 V 108.15" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <g class="tree-toggle-count">
            <rect x="196.5" y="97.5" width="17.2" height="15" rx="7.5" class="tree-count-pill"/>
            <text x="205.1" y="108.6" class="t-primary" font-size="10" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
          </g>
        </g>

        <!-- Expand all (shown only while a branch is collapsed) -->
        <g data-tree-expand-all="" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Expand all">
          <rect x="32" y="18" width="87" height="24" rx="12" stroke-width="1.2"/>
          <text x="44" y="34" class="t-primary" font-size="10.5" font-weight="650">Expand all</text>
        </g>
      </svg>
